name: Fantasy: Storybook Stickers
tagline: A fairy-tale scrapbook of die-cut stickers, where the code shines in a gold-foil magic mirror and the Wolf's mirror cracks.

fonts.display: Fraunces (SOFT 100, opsz 144) for titles, die-cut sticker lettering and the gold-foil code; Fraunces italic for the storyteller's voice
fonts.body: Figtree 500-700 for answers and body copy
fonts.ui: Figtree 700-800 for buttons, chips and labels

motifs: Every token, frame and card is a die-cut sticker: warm white border, soft shadow, slight tilt, one peeled corner
Room code in embossed gold-foil lettering inside a deep-night magic mirror
The Wolf peeks out from behind a tree sticker, eyeing the mirror
Settings on a parchment scroll, the clock tower as the countdown, Village Heroes on a calling card
A tone-on-tone fairy-tale realm (hills, castle, clock tower) printed faintly on the page
reveal: Two identical gold mirrors hold the answers; the real one blazes with a gold glory and sparkles under a 'The real Maya' ribbon, while the fake one cracks, clouds over and shows the Wolf's reflection behind the words, with 'It was the Wolf!' on a burgundy ribbon.
why: A slightly toned paper ground keeps glare down while ink, raspberry and gold-on-night give every word at least 5:1 contrast, and the oversized foil code and die-cut stickers read cleanly from across a dim room. The magic mirror turns the game's core question into one instantly readable image: which reflection is real.
